en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small historic European town seen from across open fields and orchards. In the foreground are rows of trees and meadows separated by paths or country roads. On a gentle rise in the background stands a dense cluster of multi‑story masonry houses with steep, tiled roofs. Dominating the skyline is a large church or former monastery with a tall baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome, plus a smaller cupola nearby. Surrounding hills and farmland frame the settlement. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
